I = weighted coverage on frozen C2048 of (cross OR dup), divided by full C-query weight. cross: distance<0.005L to a verified proper CF intersection segment belonging to the query C face. dup: C-interior query (border distance>=0.01L), within<0.005L of any finite nondegenerate free triangle with |normal dot|>=cos15deg. A tolerance-band proxy, not whole-mesh intersection volume or proof of redundant layers.
Weighted confirmed union plus uncertain cases; same full C-query denominator. Equals lower I here because unresolved sampled coverage is zero.
